issue: The legend defines green as 'admission event (backfill)', but the in-figure annotation says 'new sequences (green) snap into freed slots.' The new sequences are drawn blue; green marks only the admission event. This conflates the event with the sequence and can mislead readers about what continuous batching backfills.
evidence: Legend: 'admission event (backfill)' with green swatch. Bottom-right annotation: 'new sequences (green) snap into freed slots.' The blue bars after each green stripe are the new sequences.
acceptance_test: Change the annotation to 'new sequences enter at green admission events' (or recolor the new sequences green and update the legend). A reader should be able to state that green marks when a slot is refilled, not the sequence itself.

issue: The legend distinguishes 'sequence in flight' (blue solid) from 'admission event' (green solid) by color alone. In grayscale the two solid swatches may be hard to distinguish, and the figure has no grayscale note. The thin green stripes are visually different from the blue bars, but the legend does not encode that shape difference.
evidence: Legend uses a blue solid square for sequence and a green solid square for admission event; no hatch/pattern or grayscale note is present.
acceptance_test: Add a pattern/hatch or explicit label to the admission-event legend, or add a grayscale note explaining the shape distinction. Verify the legend remains unambiguous in grayscale print.

issue: The caption says 'dashed border = not in the canonical baseline,' but box 2 also has a non-solid (dotted) border and the figure has no in-figure border-style legend. A reader may infer that box 2 is also outside the canonical baseline, or may not notice which border style carries the meaning.
evidence: Box 1 solid purple, box 2 red dotted, box 3 green dash-dot, box 4 orange dashed. Caption only explains the dashed border for box 4.
acceptance_test: Add a small 'beyond canonical baseline' tag to box 4, or state in the caption that only the orange dashed border carries that meaning. Verify the distinction at print size.

issue: The 'square = one GPU (hatched = prefill)' legend and the red caveat block are set noticeably smaller than the main figure labels. At print size the legend is easy to miss and may fall below the 8 pt floor.
evidence: The legend text under panel A is visibly smaller than 'PREFILL'/'DECODE' and the body text; the red caveat block is also small.
acceptance_test: Measure the source font size and set all figure annotations to at least 8 pt, or move the square legend into the caption. Verify at 100% print size.
